newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador posts $158 mln trade surplus in November.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador posts $158 mln trade surplus in November.

text.p: Ecuador posted a $158 million trade surplus in November, up from $43 million surplus in November 1995 and a $65 million surplus in October, the Central Bank said Tuesday.
The bank said exports came in at $418 million in November compared with $374 million in November 1995 and $434 million in October. Of the total exports, $163 million accounted for oil.
Imports in November stood at $260 million, compared with $369 million in November 1995 and $337 million in October.
The central bank added the trade surplus in the first 11 months of 1996 came to $1.23 billion, sharply up from $217 million surplus in the same period of 1995.
